observations: No new photos were provided; the seller only repeated a verbal assurance.
Photo 0 shows a white PS5 console with PlayStation logo visible on the side panel.
Photo 0 shows one DualSense controller (white/black) and a coiled power cable still wrapped in plastic.
Photo 1 shows the console from the side where a disc slot is visible, confirming this is the Disc Edition, not Digital.
Photo 1 shows the same single controller and the same wrapped power cable.
No FIFA disc, disc case, HDMI cable, box, or UK receipt is visible in either photo.
Console is shown powered off in both images; no boot screen or home menu is visible.
No close-up of ports, serial number, or any visible wear/scratches on the console body.

claims.claim: Comes with FIFA disc game and accessories
claims.evidence: No disc, disc case, or accessories beyond one controller and one power cable are visible in photo 0 or photo 1; seller's verbal reassurance adds no new visual evidence.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No internal shot or seal/screw close-up provided; a verbal claim of testing does not substitute for a photo.
No power-on clip or thermal/usage evidence shown; 'I tested it myself' is a stranger's text, not proof.
No close-up of the port panel or a clip showing devices connected and functioning.
Only one controller is visible in both photo 0 and photo 1.

claims.claim: Comes with the original UK receipt
claims.evidence: No receipt is shown in either photo.

claims.claim: 'I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true'
claims.evidence: A verbal assurance with no accompanying photo or video cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (e.g. disc drive, HDMI output).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the console powering on to the home screen and reading a disc.

risks.risk: FIFA disc and other promised accessories may not be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing the disc, its case, and any other listed accessories alongside the console.

risks.risk: Only one controller may be included despite 'pads' (plural) claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing a second DualSense controller.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a single controller only

risks.risk: No HDMI cable is shown, which is normally included.
risks.proof: A photo of the HDMI cable alongside the console.

risks.risk: UK import/receipt claim cannot be confirmed, affecting warranty/authenticity value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the UK receipt with matching serial number.

risks.risk: Unit could be a refurbished or swapped-internals console despite 'never opened' claim.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number sticker on the console matching the box/receipt serial.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and loading a game or home screen.
Photo of the FIFA disc and case, and any other claimed accessories.
Photo of a second controller if 'pads' (plural) is accurate.
Clear photo of the UK receipt and the console's serial number for matching.
response.reason: The seller's repeated verbal assurance adds no new visual evidence, so the console remains identifiable but must still be priced at its worst-case configuration (single controller, no disc, unverified working state) until photographic or video proof is given.
